**STEP 1 – Scene:** This is a mixed buffet-style plate. It has two tuna nigiri, two cucumber slices, a roasted chicken piece with skin, a piece of skinless cooked chicken (or similar pale meat), and a braised lamb shank on the bone.

**STEP 2 – Vessel:** It looks like a white ribbed-rim dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².

**STEP 3 – Items:**
- Tuna nigiri (×2)
- Cucumber slices (×2)
- Roast chicken piece with skin
- Pale cooked chicken piece
- Braised lamb shank with bone

No visible sauce or oil.

**STEP 4 – Area:**

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Nigiri | 4% | ~21 cm² |
| Cucumber | 1.5% | ~8 cm² |
| Roast chicken | 6% | ~32 cm² |
| Pale chicken | 3% | ~16 cm² |
| Lamb shank | 10% | ~53 cm² |

Total coverage is about 25%, which matches a mostly empty plate.

**STEP 5–6 – Volume and grams:**

| Item | Area × height | Volume | × density | Grams |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nigiri | 21 × 2.5 | 53 ml | × 1.0 | ~53 g |
| Cucumber | 8 × 0.5 | 4 ml | × 0.7 | ~3 g (rounded up to ~6 g, since two slices) |
| Roast chicken | 32 × 3 | 96 ml | × 0.9 | ~86 g |
| Pale chicken | 16 × 1.5 | 24 ml | × 1.0 | ~24 g |
| Lamb shank | 53 × 3 | 159 ml | × 0.95 | ~150 g gross |

For the lamb shank, the bone is about 35 g, leaving roughly 115 g of edible meat.

**STEP 7 – Energy:**

| Item | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nigiri | 53 | 150 | ≈ 80 |
| Cucumber | 6 | 15 | ≈ 1 |
| Roast chicken with skin | 86 | 220 | ≈ 189 |
| Pale chicken | 24 | 165 | ≈ 40 |
| Lamb shank meat | 115 | 220 | ≈ 253 |

**STEP 8 – Sanity check:** The total is about 284 g of edible food and roughly 560 kcal. That is plausible for a sparsely filled dinner plate dominated by a lamb shank and a chicken piece.
